notes:
REF-BM-02: Fetches title, description, and favicon, but not a preview image.
REF-BM-04: URL, title, description, and tags are editable, but notes are not implemented.
REF-BM-06: Saving an existing URL creates a duplicate instead of editing the existing bookmark.
REF-BM-10: Tag input has no existing-tag autocomplete.
REF-BM-12: Search covers title, description, and URL, but no note field exists.
REF-BM-14: #tag search syntax is not parsed.
REF-BM-15: Boolean operators and parenthesised search groups are not implemented.
REF-BM-16: Quoted exact-phrase search is not implemented.
REF-BM-20: There is no multi-selection or bulk-action interface.
REF-BM-21: Actions cannot be applied to the whole filtered collection.
REF-BM-23: Bookmark notes and markdown rendering are absent.
REF-BM-24: Local HTML/PDF snapshots are absent.
REF-BM-25: Internet Archive snapshot creation is absent.
REF-BM-26: Bookmark archiving is absent.
REF-BM-27: Reversible archive versus permanent delete is not implemented.
REF-BM-28: There is no archived-bookmarks view.
REF-BM-29: Saved filter bundles are absent.
REF-BM-30: Netscape HTML import is absent.
REF-BM-31: Netscape HTML export is absent.
REF-BM-32: Personal display settings are absent.
